# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 111 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 111 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_111_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 10 — The Final Similitude Begins

**1** After I had written down all the commandments and parables from the shepherd — the angel of repentance — he came to me again and said, "I want to show you everything that the Holy Spirit, who spoke to you through the Church, revealed to you. That Spirit is the Son of God. **2** In your earlier weakness in the flesh, it wasn't possible for you to receive it through an angel directly. But when you were strengthened through the Spirit and grew powerful, then you were capable of seeing an angel — and that's when the tower's construction was revealed to you through the Church. You saw it all properly and reverently, without any fear of the angel." **3** A few days later I saw the Glorious One. "What do you want?" he asked. **4** "Lord," I said, "please tell the Shepherd — the angel of repentance — to leave my house." **5** "He will stay with you," he said, "for as long as you live." **6** "Why?" I asked. **7** "Because the Lord has seen your simplicity and innocence," he said. "The Lord places great value on these qualities in you. That's why I was sent to be with you permanently — to keep you safe from all wickedness and help you live rightly." **8** "Lord," I said, "I am deeply honoured by your presence and company." **9** "That's good to say. But those around you need to be watchful too — the people in your life will be a great benefit to you." **10** "Lord, when exactly will the tower be finished?" I asked. "It is being built right now," he said, "as you're watching. At this very moment, everything you're seeing is being brought to pass."

---

*PNEUMA emphasizes the "right now" nature of the tower's construction — the eschatological is not merely future but presently occurring.*
